models.description: Union Alpha through the opencode Go subscription using the Messages API. OpenCode publishes this as a stealth model and does not name its maker. The 262,144-token window and 131,072-token output limit are OpenCode's models.dev figures for this id; Codex compacts at 131,072 so a full-length completion still fits. OpenCode documents reasoning but publishes an empty effort list, so the stored single high level is this repository's conservative default. Access is currently free for a limited time.
models.availabilityNux: Union Alpha is OpenCode Go's new stealth coding model. Access is currently free for a limited time.
